READY 03ebed68 PR #677 (QA PC one-off; its step 4 NOT REPRODUCED, see below); planner ACCEPT; merged c1975286 (refreshed 461bbcb6, patch-id = the reviewed head; trees equal; Aaron 19:47:42Z 'merge SIA #677', relay-check verified); main rebuilt c1975286. ROOT CAUSE CORRECTED, first-hand on the desktop: ConvertTo-Json escapes control characters (\u001a) on BOTH PCs (PS 5.1.19041.6456, CLR 4.0.30319.42000). The raw C0 bytes are made on the PowerShell-to-Node pipe by the console's OEM cp437 best-fit encoder: → 0x1A, ← 0x1B, ↑ 0x18, ↓ 0x19, ↔ 0x1D, • 0x07, § 0x15, ¶ 0x14, ☺ 0x01, ► 0x10 (other non-ASCII: U+FFFD or a best-fit ASCII). So any process whose command line held an arrow or a bullet broke the table on every Windows host, and the brief's raw-0x1A sleeper could never reproduce (the brief now carries a Correction section). LIVE CHECK PASS (main build c1975286, desktop): a payload built inside PowerShell with [char]0x2192 arrives with a raw 0x1A and parses (2 rows, ppid kept); the live table loads (561 rows).
